canonical_example.translation: Many people lost their homes after the financial crisis.

canonical_example.text: Las crisis de ansiedad son cada vez más comunes entre los jóvenes.
canonical_example.translation: Anxiety attacks are increasingly frequent among young people.

canonical_example.text: Clari toma un medicamento especial para evitar las crisis de epilepsia.
canonical_example.translation: Clari takes a special medicine to avoid epileptic fits.

canonical_example.text: Agustín se está recuperando bien de la crisis cardiaca.
canonical_example.translation: Agustín is recovering well from his heart failure.

canonical_example.translation: We're going to cross the border at Tijuana.

canonical_example.text: Roberto cruzó el puente para entrar al pueblo.
canonical_example.translation: Roberto went across the bridge to enter the town.

canonical_example.text: Nunca le cruza por la cabeza ayudarme.
canonical_example.translation: It never crosses her mind to help me.

canonical_example.text: El gurú se sentó tranquilamente y cruzó las piernas para meditar.
canonical_example.translation: The guru sat down quietly and crossed his legs to meditate.

canonical_example.text: El niño cruzó los brazos y me quedó mirando fijamente.
canonical_example.translation: The boy folded his arms and stood there looking at me intently.

canonical_example.text: Desde que se separaron, ya no cruzan palabras al encontrarse.
canonical_example.translation: Since they broke up, they don't exchange any words when they meet.

canonical_example.text: Los granjeros cruzaron una yegua con un burro para conseguir una mula.

canonical_example.text: Cruza esta palabra que escribiste dos veces.
canonical_example.translation: Cross out this word that you wrote twice.

canonical_example.text: Steven cruzó el cheque para poder depositarlo.
canonical_example.translation: Steven crossed the cheque in order to be able to deposit it.

canonical_example.text: Aparcamos el coche enfrente de la discoteca.
canonical_example.translation: We parked the car in front of the club.

canonical_example.text: Debes enfrentar tus problemas y no enterrar la cabeza en la arena.
canonical_example.translation: You should face your problems and not bury your head in the sand.

canonical_example.text: Debes enfrentarte a tus miedos y abordar ese avión.
canonical_example.translation: You should face your fears and board that plane.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué le dirías si lo tuvieras enfrente?
canonical_example.translation: What would you say to him if he was in front of you?

canonical_example.text: Las autoridades enfrentaron al sospechoso tan pronto como lo encontraron.
canonical_example.translation: The authorities confronted the suspect as soon as they found him.

canonical_example.text: Nuestra casa enfrenta a la plaza del pueblo.
canonical_example.translation: Our house faces the town square.

canonical_example.text: Enfrentamos las piezas de ajedrez antes de jugar.
canonical_example.translation: We put the chess pieces face to face before playing.

canonical_example.text: La guerra civil enfrentó a muchos hermanos.
canonical_example.translation: The civil war set many brothers against one another.

canonical_example.text: Los carneros son conocidos por enfrentarse para establecer su territorio.
canonical_example.translation: Rams are known for fighting to establish their territory.

canonical_example.text: Esta noche Barcelona se enfrentará al Real Madrid en la Copa del Rey.
canonical_example.translation: Barcelona will meet Real Madrid tonight in the Copa del Rey.

canonical_example.text: El arresto del sospechoso de asesinato se produjo después de que la policía descubriera pruebas incriminatorias.
canonical_example.translation: The arrest of the murder suspect took place after the police discovered some incriminating evidence.

canonical_example.text: La policía arrestó al principal sospechoso del crimen.
canonical_example.translation: The police arrested the main suspect in the crime.

canonical_example.text: El enemigo no liberaría nuestros soldados de su arresto hasta que acordamos firmar el tratado.
canonical_example.translation: The enemy wouldn't release our soldiers from their detention until we agreed to sign the treaty.

canonical_example.text: Arrestaron a Luis por golpear a su esposa.
canonical_example.translation: Luis was detained for hitting his wife.

canonical_example.text: Los soldados insubordinados fueron arrestados por una semana.
canonical_example.translation: The insubordinate soldiers were confined to barracks for a week.

canonical_example.text: ¿Será que te arrestas a lanzarte en paracaídas?
canonical_example.translation: Would you dare to go skydiving?

canonical_example.text: El niño gritó cuando vio la araña.
canonical_example.translation: The kid screamed when he saw the spider.

canonical_example.text: Hay alguien gritando en la calle.
canonical_example.translation: There's someone shouting in the street.

canonical_example.text: No voy a responder si estás gritando.
canonical_example.translation: I am not going to reply if you are yelling.

canonical_example.text: El entrenador gritó las jugadas a su equipo.
canonical_example.translation: The coach shouted the plays to his team.

canonical_example.text: Las animadoras gritaron el lema de la escuela.
canonical_example.translation: The cheerleaders yelled the school motto.

canonical_example.text: Por favor no me grites en frente de mis amigos, mamá.
canonical_example.translation: Please don't yell at me in front of my friends, Mom.
